guidelines.detail: same as LRN-016 (The description identifies the customer's order placement as the initiating action. The reference models it as an activity, while the generated model represents the start only with a start event. This is the same guidance as LRN-016.)

same as LRN-012 (The generated label omits the sending action explicitly stated alongside generating the confirmation (P3, S2). The other label pairs match details present in the description, so they do not support treating those details as errors. LRN-012 already expresses the same principle of preserving stated actions in labels.)

same as LRN-009 (The description identifies online and phone ordering as alternatives, and the records show reference flows involving an exclusive gateway and the online-order activity that are absent from the generated model. LRN-009 already gives essentially the same guidance for mutually exclusive alternatives that later continue in common.)

same as LRN-009 (The description identifies two alternative ways to place an order, and the records show the start-to-gateway and gateway-to-alternative flows missing from the generated model. This is already covered essentially by learned guideline LRN-009.)

same as LRN-012 (The description says the system both generates and sends the confirmation, while the generated task label omits sending. LRN-012 already calls for a concise label that preserves the stated action, so this guideline expresses the same principle for activities described with multiple actions.)

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description identifies work performed by a participant as the first step of the process: Model that work as an activity after a start event and before the subsequent activity; do not represent the work itself as the start event.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description identifies a participant performing an action that initiates the process

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description states a specific activity or process-ending outcome: Label the corresponding BPMN activity or end event with a concise phrase that preserves the stated action or outcome; do not substitute a related action or add an unsupported one.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states multiple actions as part of one activity

rules_sent_back.instruction: When the description presents mutually exclusive alternatives or says an activity may or may not occur, and the paths later continue in common: Model the choice with an exclusive gateway, and reconnect the alternative paths with an exclusive merge before their shared continuation.
rules_sent_back.situation: the description states that a process can be initiated through mutually exclusive alternatives
